content:
morgan liu: Hey team — quick heads up, I submitted a request to switch to a 'quiet desk zone' near the east windows for 6 weeks. My concentration's been tanking with the daily hardware test sessions in the north bench.

alex reyes: Ah sorry Morgan — I've been running bench validation at 10:30–11:30am mostly. We can try moving those tests. Didn't realize it was causing trouble.

morgan liu: Thanks Alex. It's the intermittent loud fans + periodic door deliveries at the same time that break my flow. Not trying to escalate, just asking if we can find a swap or quiet window.

jamal patel: Looping Tara from People Ops to help mediate and coordinate options. Morgan, is this an ongoing thing you expect to continue beyond a month?

morgan liu: Probably 6–8 weeks while I'm finalizing a report. If we can arrange consistent quiet hours or a temporary desk move that would help. I'm open to partial remote on the heavy-focus days too.

tara (people-ops): Thanks Jamal. Morgan — we can do a few things: 1) temporary desk reassignment to a quieter zone, 2) formal accommodation request (ADA-style) if needed, 3) set a quiet-hours agreement with the bench team, or 4) noise-mitigation kit (headphones + acoustic screen) from Facilities. Which would you prefer to try first?

morgan liu: I'd prefer desk reassignment if there's space. If not, headphones + a screen would be fine. I can file an accommodation if needed but wanted to try informal routes first.

alex reyes: We have two empty desks in the west wing but they're near the printer. Not ideal. Facilities — any chance of moving Morgan to the east window zone temporarily? @facilities

facilities: Hey all — we can do a temporary seat swap for up to 8 weeks. Need a start date and confirmation we won't break any booked seating. Can also provide an acoustic panel and high-fi headphones.

tara (people-ops): Okay — plan: 1) Morgan, confirm preferred start date. 2) Facilities to reserve a desk and note the kit if needed. 3) Jamal, please ask Alex to avoid running bench tests 10:15–11:45 on Morgan's deep-work days, or move them earlier/later. If we can't get adherence we'll escalate to a formal accommodation.

morgan liu: Start date next Monday (2026-04-05) would be great. I'll mark Tue/Thu as deep-focus days for now.

alex reyes: I can move the bench window to 9–10am on Tue/Thu. Sorry again Morgan — I'll also sign up for quieter slots in the calendar.

tara (people-ops): Noted. Morgan — if the desk swap happens, we consider this an informal accommodation. If you need documentation for Manager or benefits, file via the HR portal and tag me and I'll fast-track. If at any point noise becomes a health issue, tell us and we'll open the formal ADA process.

morgan liu: Appreciate it. Quick Q for facilities: will the acoustic screen be permanent at the temporary desk or do I need to install it?

facilities: We'll set it up on move day and remove it when the temporary assignment ends.

people-ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Quiet-zone check-in" Tue 2026-04-13 10:00 (15m) with Morgan, Jamal, Tara — calendar invites sent.

jamal patel: Thanks all. Folks — let's treat this as low-friction first. If anything falls through ping me and Tara. :thumbsup:

morgan liu: Thanks everyone. Really helps to have options. :relieved:
